Theorem
[Energy estimates] ↗ thm:monotonicity-approximate-solutions ↗ thm:poincares-inequality-connected 1. ch9:9.1-thm-2\group Energy Estimates

There exists a constant $C$, depending only on $U$ and $\mathbf{a}$, such that \[ \| u_m\| _{H^1_0(U)} \leq C(1 + \| f\| _{L^2(U)}) \tag {11} \] for $m = 1, 2, \ldots $.

Proof

\sketch Multiply (7) by $d_m^k$ and sum over $k$. Coercivity bounds $\| Du_m\| _2^2$ by a constant plus $\int _Ufu_m$; Cauchy’s inequality and Poincare’s inequality absorb the $u_m$ term and give (11).

□
